title: Los lugares de One Piece en el mapa
caption:
#EpicPartner Los lugares de One Piece en el mapa de Fortnite 🏴‍☠️ Playa de Buggy, el Baratie, Arlong Park, el Bosque Mandarina de Nami y Loguetown: dónde está cada uno y su historia en el anime.
¿Cuál es tu favorito? 👇
Usa el código BAD en la tienda de objetos 💛
#Fortnite #OnePiece #FortniteEspañol

claims.text: Noticia del juego: Atuendos Monkey D. Luffy, Nami y Usopp ('Cuando la aventura llama, ¡los Sombreros de Paja responden!')
match: Atuendos Monkey D. Luffy, Nami y Usopp
Cuando la aventura llama, ¡los Sombreros de Paja responden!

claims.text: 5 lugares del mapa con nombres de One Piece: Playa de Buggy, Baratie, Arlong Park, Bosque Mandarina de Nami y Loguetown
match: Playa de Buggy
Baratie
Arlong Park
Bosque Mandarina de Nami
Loguetown
claims.visual: each of the five names carries a One Piece name (Buggy, Baratie, Arlong Park, Nami, Loguetown; the One Piece Wiki pages in sources/ describe each); the other 11 places on the map (Bahía Bulliciosa, Campo de batalla del gigante, Caverna Condenada, El cofre, Frontera Farol, Henry, La calavera salada, Puerto Pirata, Resort relajado, The $.$. Rocky, Villa Molino) carry no One Piece name

claims.text: Dónde está cada uno: Playa de Buggy: Norte · cerca de Frontera Farol; Baratie: Sureste · cerca de Bahía Bulliciosa; Arlong Park: Oeste · cerca de Frontera Farol; Bosque Mandarina de Nami: Suroeste · cerca de Villa Molino; Loguetown: Sur · cerca de Villa Molino
match: Playa de Buggy
Baratie
Arlong Park
Bosque Mandarina de Nami
Loguetown

claims.text: La ruta sigue el viaje de Luffy: Buggy (uno de sus primeros enemigos), el Baratie (de ahí zarpan a Cocoyasi), Arlong Park y el huerto de Bell-mère en Cocoyasi, Loguetown (después de Mihawk)
match: One of the earliest enemies defeated by Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates
He is the main antagonist of the Orange Town Arc and a secondary antagonist in the Loguetown Arc
claims.visual: order also from onepiece-wiki-baratie.json ('so he, Monkey D. Luffy and Yosaku could sail to Cocoyasi Village'), onepiece-wiki-bell-mere.json ('her mikan grove in Cocoyasi Village') and onepiece-wiki-loguetown.json (Zoro replaces the swords Mihawk shattered, a fight told in the Baratie arc)

claims.text: Buggy: pirata payaso, capitán de los Piratas de Buggy
match: Buggy the Star Clown
in time becoming captain of the Buggy Pirates

claims.text: Buggy fue aprendiz en la tripulación de Gol D. Roger, junto a Shanks
match: Initially a Roger Pirates apprentice alongside Shanks

claims.text: Uno de los primeros enemigos que derrotaron Luffy y los Sombreros de Paja; villano principal del arco de Orange Town
match: One of the earliest enemies defeated by Monkey D. Luffy and the Straw Hat Pirates
He is the main antagonist of the Orange Town Arc

claims.text: Hoy es uno de los cuatro Emperadores del Nuevo Mundo y dice que va a ser el Rey de los Piratas
match: one of the current Four Emperors dominating the New World
Buggy has declared his intent to become the Pirate King

claims.text: El Baratie: restaurante en el mar, un barco bastante grande con cabeza de pez
match: The Baratie is an ocean-going restaurant run by Zeff.
The Baratie is a fairly large ship.
has a fish as a front-piece/head

claims.text: Lo dirige Zeff, famoso ex capitán pirata y jefe de cocina
match: The Baratie is owned and headed by Zeff
Its owner is a renowned former pirate captain
Zeff assumed the position of head chef

claims.text: Zeff lo fundó con la ayuda de Sanji, de 10 años; Sanji fue su joven subchef
match: who founded it 11 years ago with the help of a 10-year-old Sanji
with Sanji becoming the young sous chef

claims.text: Luffy dañó el restaurante: contrato de un año; deuda saldada al salvar el Baratie de Don Krieg
match: Luffy was made into a temporary chore boy under this system after damaging the restaurant, and was contracted for a year of employment, though his debts were ultimately cleared after he saved the restaurant from Don Krieg.

claims.text: De ahí, Sanji zarpó con Luffy rumbo a la aldea Cocoyasi
match: was given to Sanji, so he, Monkey D. Luffy and Yosaku could sail to Cocoyasi Village.

claims.text: Sanji: 1600 pavos, hasta el 5 dic
match: "regularPrice": 1600, "finalPrice": 1600, "devName": "[VIRTUAL]1 x Sanji, 1 x Sanji's Utensils, 1 x Sanji's Utensils for -1 MtxCurrency", "offerId": "v2:/258c82518cff648c6989eb3d14a1c144ed27d7553882c5ca61979afa959cdc0b", "inDate": "2026-11-08T00:00:00Z", "outDate": "

claims.text: Arlong Park: la base de los Piratas de Arlong
match: Arlong Park was the Arlong Pirates' base of operations.

claims.text: Arlong llegó al East Blue diez años antes, a la aldea Cocoyasi, con un plan para conquistar y gobernar a los humanos
match: A decade before the Arlong Park arc, Arlong led his pirate crew to the East Blue on an island called Cocoyasi Village, where he initiated his plan to conquer and rule over humans.

claims.text: Desarmó su galeón y con esas piezas construyó Arlong Park, un edificio de ocho pisos
match: He dismantled his original galleon and repurposed the materials to build Arlong Park, an eight-story building that served as his headquarters.

claims.text: En plena costa, con su bandera pirata arriba, para mostrar que no le tenían miedo a la ley
match: their Jolly Roger at the top, was conspicuously placed at the coast to show that they had no fear of the law

claims.text: Luffy lo destruyó con su Gomu Gomu no Ono, Arlong cayó cinco pisos; quedó hecho escombros
match: The entire building was destroyed by Luffy's Gomu Gomu no Ono, smashing Arlong through five stories downwards.
The destruction extended to Arlong Park itself, which was reduced to rubble.

claims.text: Noticia del juego: Come la fruta Goma Goma para estirar tus habilidades como Luffy
match: Frutas del diablo por toda la isla
Come la fruta Goma Goma para estirar tus habilidades como Luffy

claims.text: Nami creció en un huerto de mandarinas (mikan), en la aldea Cocoyasi
match: Bell-mère lived with the girls on her mikan grove in Cocoyasi Village.
claims.visual: mikan is a mandarin orange (mandarina); the Fortnite place is the Bosque Mandarina de Nami

claims.text: Bell-mère: ex oficial de la Marina, dueña del huerto, madre adoptiva de Nami y de su hermana Nojiko
match: Bell-mère was a former Marine officer, the owner of a mikan farm in Cocoyasi Village, and the adoptive mother of Nami and Nojiko.

claims.text: Cuando los tiempos eran difíciles, comía solo la fruta de su huerto para que a sus hijas no les faltara comida, y decía que estaba a dieta
match: when times were harsh, she ate only the fruit she grew in her grove, thus saving enough money to keep feeding her daughters on suitable meals, and would lie about being on a "diet" to hide it.

claims.text: Las crió unos nueve años, hasta que Arlong le quitó la vida
match: She raised the two girls in her hometown for approximately nine years until she was murdered by Arlong.

claims.text: Después, Nami tuvo que unirse a la tripulación de Arlong para dibujar mapas del mar
match: Nami was forced to join Arlong's crew for her cartography skills, which they planned to use to create sea charts

claims.text: Loguetown, la ciudad del principio y del fin: ahí nació y fue ejecutado Gol D. Roger, el antiguo Rey de los Piratas
match: The town is famed as both the birthplace and the execution site of the former Pirate King, Gol D. Roger.
Town of the Beginning and the End

claims.text: Muy cerca de Reverse Mountain; casi todos los barcos del East Blue paran ahí a abastecerse
match: lying in close proximity to the Reverse Mountain
makes it an essential stop for almost all East Blue ships, especially pirate ships, seeking to resupply

claims.text: Zoro buscó espadas nuevas porque Mihawk le había roto dos
match: It was here that Zoro sought replacements for two of his swords after Dracule Mihawk shattered them.

claims.text: La Yubashiri era la espada más valiosa de la tienda de Ipponmatsu, hasta que llegó Zoro
match: Until Roronoa Zoro's visit, the most prized possession in Ipponmatsu's collection was the esteemed sword Yubashiri.

claims.text: Luffy se subió a la plataforma donde ejecutaron a Roger; Buggy y Alvida lo atraparon ahí
match: Luffy visited the Roger's execution platform, eventually climbing on it, eager to take in the view.
While standing atop the platform, Luffy was suddenly ambushed by Buggy and Alvida

claims.text: Buggy intentó ejecutar a Luffy (arco de Loguetown)
match: Buggy attempts to execute Luffy for revenge.
a secondary antagonist in the Loguetown Arc

claims.text: Un rayo de una tormenta muy extraña cayó sobre la plataforma y la destruyó
match: the platform was struck by a freak lightning storm and obliterated
